---
title: SWOT Hydrocron Time Series Tutorials
subtitle: Example workflows using Hydrocron
---

Hydrocron is an API that repackages hydrology datasets from the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) satellite into formats that make time-series analysis easier. Below are examples of using the Hydrocron API programmatically to access and analyze SWOT hydrology data. For more details and user guides please see the Hydrocron Documentation [https://podaac.github.io/hydrocron/](https://podaac.github.io/hydrocron/)

## Tutorials
